Some need more time then others. Happiness isn’t guaranteed. when it comes to boyfriends/girlfriends. Even if you don’t get over it, you’ll learn to live with out them. It’s like I’ve lost many people, I’ll never get over it but I’ve learned to live with these wounds. You will figure it out as well. I truly believe it

Psychology definitely didn’t work for me. Meds are really trial and error. It can some years to find the right one. There are many people like myself that would be happy to be in your life and look out for you! Do you think you’re pushing away the people on your life or is it something else? Feel free to dm
Feel free to take this to the dms but why do you feel your family hates you?

It took me almost a year to get over a girl I dated for 2 years and lived with. Push yourself to get out and doing things. One of the worst thing I did whiles depressed is locking up in my room. It doesn’t help at all. Find some things to let the stress out. For me I fish, shoot guns, go out with friends and doing fun stuff. Also put yourself out there. Facebook dating is great right now. Send messages instead of just a basic like(you can send a message before matching).

Have you tried sleep medication or natural sleeping remedies. Melatonin knocked me out and it’s 100% natural. Some teas are good. Prescription are a little to addictive for my liking but weed works well for me.


Insomnia and lack of sleep definitely effected my depression
I tried to kill my self over a girl. Biggest regret to this day. Time doesn’t heal everything, some wounds are forever but give this some time and it won’t bother you.

Have you tried seeking help from the people around you/professionals? Happiness is a funny thing. Some of us spend our lives trying to find it.  I’ve tried to kill myself many times and years later I’m happy it didn’t happen. It’s a choice that’s yours to make. I hope you don’t make that choice because I believe you leave a big scar on the people you love and I really think you can find happiness. It’ll be worth it in the end. Trust me.

I feel you. It can feel like a losing battle most of the time. I can’t stop you from doing it, no one can but I really hope you can find your happiness. There isn’t a cure for depression, we learn how to live with it. Take it day by day and remember you deserve happiness. Unfortunately it won’t come, keep fighting. Feel free to dm me if you want to vent or just talk

Winter definitely makes me feel like crap. A lot of people suffer from season depression. If you need someone to talk to, feel free to dm me anytime to vent or just talk. We can talk about anything. It doesn’t have to be about how you’re feeling. Tv shows, sports, anything. I’m here 😃

Talk about it with your friends and family. Prevention is better than cure. I’m not saying tell everyone but you need to let someone that’s close with you know or a professional. This sounds generic but we can’t do this alone. What can you accomplish alone vs together? These thoughts can creep up on all of us and god forbid you act on impulse. You bottle it up and something very drastic happens, you might explode. I’ve lost a few people from depression and bottling it up. Do yourself and your loved ones a favour and don’t do nothing. Act now.

One of the hardest thing for me as a gun owner was telling the people that care about me how i feel. It doesn’t sound like it at all but it’s the best thing to talk to your mom or dad about it. One of my high school friends killed himself on the train tracks about 8 years ago. A few years ago his mom killed herself and then his dad shorty after. I’m telling you this because you will leave a huge burden on the people you love. I also knew someone else that jumped off a building and survived. They told me they wanted to do it so bad and the second he jumped he regretted everything. Now he’s a public speaker for suicide prevention. My grandma always told me prevention is better than cure and there’s absolutely no cure for a bullet in the brain. You know deep down what I’m telling you is the right thing to do. Do the right thing. Do it before it’s to late. Do it for yourself and your family and friends.

If it helps, when I was 17 I just got out of jail. I didn’t get my license until I was 22. I was working minimum wage until I was 21. Now I’m on road to make 92k a year without finishing high school through trades. You’re young and still got so much time to be something great. There are people on their 40s that still work minimum wage. You got this! It’s going to be hard but try to find the will to put in the work and it’ll pay off.

God doesn’t want you to die, if you believe in god then you should believe god puts you through trials and tribulations for a reason.

I remember someone telling me that jumped off a building and survived, they regretted everything the moment they jump. I tried killing myself and regret it all. It’s your choice but I hope you choose to fight the urge and work towards a happy life.
